notes.title: Patch 1.1.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some hotkeys not to activate while any modifier key is pressed.
[*] Added a new option in the Settings tab to add an offset to the crosshair.
[*] Added mirroring axes to pixel editor.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Improved connection between the application and the full-screen gamebar extension, it should be more consistent. [i][b]If the gamebar extension doesn't connect, make sure that it is updated on the [url=https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9nl54bb019xf?hl=en-us&gl=US&ocid=pdpshare]Microsoft Store[/url][/b][/i].
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Active Display option to show only when ADS is enabled.
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/fdhCv2DqfK]Discord[/url] to share your suggestions and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.content:
[i]In this patch, we are adding a new option to allow you to change the display on which the crosshair is on, and fixing a few bugs.[/i]

[list]
[*] Added "Active Display" option, which will affect only the normal overlay.
[*] Fixed a bug causing some hotkeys to be activated with the wrong key.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the extension from connecting with the client in some cases.
[*] Fixed the extension not centering correctly and added auto-centering when pinning it.
[/list]

Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/fdhCv2DqfK]Discord[/url] to share your suggestions and feedback!
